input.quote: Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman.
input.rationale: Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "interest" and "shall pay" return no provision imposing liquidated damages, penalties, late-payment interest, accelerated fees or a minimum/early-termination fee on Sparkling. Section 11 obliges Sparkling only to pay fees per the Fee Schedule; Section 17(b) permits termination for convenience on 90 days' notice with no exit payment; Section 17 (p0128) in fact runs in our favour (perpetual licence and refund of prepaid fees on Garman's default). Section 15 limits damages to direct damages for both parties, and the mutual non-solicitation in Section 19 carries no stipulated payment. This meets the preferred position of no liquidated damages or penalties payable by the Customer, so no redline is required.
